PIM → Data QA → Odoo Import Test → Website Preview → Technical/Commercial Approval → Publish.
Relational PIM governance: Attribute Profiles, Cross Reference, Compatibility, Brand/Supplier, Industry/Application matrices, Product Relationships and Technical RFQ Engine.
PRODUCT → CATEGORY → PRODUCT FAMILY → ATTRIBUTE PROFILE → VARIANT → DOCUMENT / CROSS REFERENCE / COMPATIBILITY / RELATIONSHIPS.
Digital Product Distribution Platform: Search → Technical Discovery → RFQ → Sales → Procurement/Inventory → Delivery → Repeat Order.
Supplier/source intelligence, internal supply status, cost and sourcing logic are internal/private and must not be exposed publicly.
